adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in LarkCalendarService.ts, the code uses `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` which always takes the first element (index 0) of the destinationCalendar array. Unlike GoogleCalendarService which was updated to use `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)` to match the correct calendar based on credentialId, LarkCalendarService always uses the first calendar. This means for collective team events where multiple hosts have different destination calendars, secondary hosts would incorrectly target the first host's calendar instead of their own.
